test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - GK/CA (Held on: 02 Dec, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: gk
question:
Identify the correct statement in the context of five-year plans in India.

(i) In the first five-year plan, the top priority was given to agriculture.

(ii) In the second five-year plan, the top priority was given to industry.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Both (i) and (ii) **__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **First Five-Year Plan (1951–1956):**

 
 
• The** top priority was given to agriculture.**
 
• This **was essential due to food shortages and the need to achieve self-sufficiency in food production.**
 
• Major initiatives included investments in irrigation, land reforms, and community development programs.
 
• **Hence this statement is true**
 
 
 
• **Second Five-Year Plan (1956–1961)**:
 
 
• The** top priority was given to industry, particularly heavy industries.**
 
• **This plan focused on building the foundation for industrial growth, emphasizing sectors like steel, power, and infrastructure.**
 
• It followed the Mahalanobis model, which stressed the importance of industrialization for economic growth.
 
• **Hence this statement is also true**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Basic information about planning commission and 5-year plans:

 
 
• Planning commission founded: 1950.
 
• Planning Commission head: Prime Minister
 
• First five-year plan launched: in 1951
 
• A total number of 5-year plans: 12.
 
• Last five-year plan: 2012 to 2017 (Under PM Manmohan Singh).
 
• Planning Commission dissolved: 2014 (By PM Narendra Modi).
